subject: Intrinsic functions
notes: kb/Work PB124 wave 5c, re-witnessed by kb/Work PB1425 (w1020c). "An object reference shall be specified; the predefined object reference SUPER shall not be specified" (15.3 item 11). pb61's CARR line carries OBJECT REFERENCE and PROGRAM-POINTER legs (LENGTH / BYTE-LENGTH 8/8). SELF and SUPER are now identifiers of the expression tier (8.4.3.1.2 Format 6), so the refusal of SUPER is no longer a parse accident: FUNCTION LENGTH(SUPER) is refused by name, COBOL2900 (8.4.3.8.3 SR3 - SUPER only as an invocation's or a property's object), and FUNCTION LENGTH(SELF) in a method is the legal type-11 argument (golden pb1425_predefined_object_operands: LENGTH(SELF) = LENGTH(O)). retired-witness: conformance-test:IntrinsicFunctionDifferentialTests.Length_SuperIsStructurallyUnparseable (renamed Length_SuperIsRefusedByName by kb/Work PB1425: SUPER is now an expression-tier identifier refused by 8.4.3.8.3 SR3 (COBOL2900), not a parse error) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/Procedure/Verbs/IntrinsicBinder.cs#LengthPositions (LengthPositions moved out of IntrinsicBinder and is ItemLength.Positions (kb/Work PB1213, 7d4f0a4a4))
